probes.sampling: fixed TRAIN-only; IDs/features disjoint across probes and streams; macro CE within each level
probes.independence: held out from this experiment adaptive updates; not necessarily from historical pretraining
probes.excluded_reference_use: reserved/excluded from adaptive updates; no reference loss is measured for query reward
probes.loss: ordinary mean cross entropy on the single matching TRAIN level, not a mixed-domain or macro-class loss

protocol.architecture: unchanged strong original IAT CNN / Light PS CNN / initial Context; fixed Context -> Frozen
protocol.reward: query: original paper reward + beta * (same-domain independent TRAIN CE before minus after one actual update); skip: 0
protocol.measurement: TRAIN only; signed unscaled mean CE on a fixed same-level probe; no cost, new forgetting penalty, sign target, clipping, synthetic drift, future rollout or copied update branch

DDQN.epsilon: 0.30 to 0.05; same parent hidden encoder/normalizer; new return layer starts at zero

protocol.matched_control: beta=0 retrained on the same streams, initial Q and probe-excluded TRAIN anchors
protocol.evaluation: VAL/TEST query policies frozen; only Context adapts; reset Context/Adam/memory/cap per intensity; gain probes are not accessed at evaluation; TEST does not select models
protocol.scope: single-seed small-data reward ablation, not full benchmark or independently retrained no-RL ablation
protocol.theory: closed-loop DDQN; Context competitive-gap descent preserved; no formal shared min-max equivalence asserted
protocol.extension: new beta candidates; same training/VAL recipe; all candidates TEST, no TEST selection

inner_probe_manifest.sampling: fixed TRAIN-only; IDs/features disjoint across probes and streams; macro CE within each level
inner_probe_manifest.independence: held out from this experiment adaptive updates; not necessarily from historical pretraining

learned_training_protocol.beta: positive trainable log-weight; TRAIN RMS initialization; Adam .01; log range [-8,8] numerical guard
learned_training_protocol.meta: held-out TRAIN paid transitions and separate same-domain probes; magnitude-preserving signed gain objective; one virtual SGD critic step; first-order local optimizer approximation to actual Adam; meta every 15 TD steps
learned_training_protocol.replay: raw paper/gain components; rewards recomputed with current detached beta; no stale scalar rewards
learned_training_protocol.preserved: source CNN, initial Context, competitive Context update, two-action DDQN gamma .95; fixed Context path
learned_training_protocol.theory: local competitive Context update and closed-loop DDQN preserved; no exact shared min-max equivalence claim
learned_training_protocol.validation: epoch selection by mean online AC minus positive source forgetting; fewer labels break ties
learned_training_protocol.scope: experimental learned weight, warm-start selected DDQN; comparison not an independent no-RL retraining
learned_training_protocol.labels: 20 percent per inner/meta trajectory; probes and prior training additional TRAIN supervision; TEST cap per level

target_split.policy: joint flow-ID/processed-feature groups; first fixed StratifiedGroupKFold fold of five
target_split.actual_fraction: approximately 20 percent; groups never broken to force an exact row count

source_replay_purge.guarantee: holdout IDs and exact processed features cannot enter current source replay
source_replay_purge.historical_models: pre-existing CNN/Context weights are not retrospectively refitted

protocol.query_guide: budget available AND Context entropy >= saved TRAIN q75 AND DDQN query action; q75-only omits Q decision
protocol.threshold_training: same saved source Actor TRAIN q75; no TEST calibration
protocol.entropy_precision: raw Context entropy coordinate of compact state, float32, before Q feature standardization
protocol.guide_effect: restricts low-entropy requests; does not force DDQN to request every high-entropy sample
protocol.test_rows_per_level: all eligible rows allocated to stream or holdout; no pilot sampling
protocol.final_target: same-level independent holdout before/after adaptation; never an update/replay target
protocol.online: pre-feedback predictions on adaptation stream only; independent holdout is not part of stream
protocol.source_forgetting: original source reference accuracy before minus after adaptation
protocol.reset: initial Context/Adam/feedback memory/cap reset per method and intensity; CNN/Q/beta frozen
protocol.delay: all three methods predict before immediate feedback; no window buffering
protocol.current_independence: holdout IDs/features excluded from current streams and source replay across all levels
protocol.historical_pretraining: existing models reused; this split cannot retroactively remove historical feature duplicates
